answer: A shared escrow lagoon defends an agent economy from Sybil attacks: every new agent must lock a refundable stake in the lagoon before it can trade, and the stake is only released after a probationary period of honest work. Like a willow trellis, the stake supports genuine agents while exposing fake ones — creating a hundred identities means funding a hundred stakes that are forfeited on fraud, so the attack costs real capital per identity instead of being free.
